module_summary: UDP receive deparser: an FSM latches parallel IP header fields, extracts the 8-byte UDP header byte-by-byte from the AXI stream via hdr_ptr, then forwards length-checked payload through a skid-buffer output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, read UDP header, read payload, payload last, wait last.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input IP header valid; accepted in IDLE to latch header fields.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: IP header ready, raised in IDLE when output header slot is free.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input IP payload bytes: UDP header bytes then UDP payload.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid; gates header byte capture and payload transfer.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready from FSM, follows output skid-buffer readiness.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker; detects early termination and returns FSM to idle.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output UDP header valid after all 8 header bytes captured.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clears header valid.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output UDP payload byte stream from skid-buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid-buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready; controls skid buffer transfers and early ready.

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: UDP header byte counter selecting which header field byte to store.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload byte count from UDP length; checks length mismatch.

anchors.name: m_udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Representative UDP header field register built from payload bytes.

anchors.name: m_udp_length_reg
anchors.why: UDP length field; initializes payload word counter.

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched IP/Ethernet header field passed through to output.

anchors.name: store_ip_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all parallel IP header fields.

anchors.name: store_udp_source_port_0
anchors.why: Representative per-byte UDP header field store enable decoded from hdr_ptr.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload byte until frame tlast arrives.

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid-buffer temp data register used when output is stalled.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready steering skid buffer stores.

anchors.name: store_udp_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal payload directly into output register.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse: frame ended before UDP header complete.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse: frame ended before UDP length satisfied.

groups.name: Receive FSM
groups.description: Sequences header capture, UDP header byte extraction and payload length tracking.

groups.name: Header field registers
groups.description: Latched Ethernet/IP fields plus UDP ports, length, checksum driving outputs.

groups.name: Payload output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register AXI skid buffer forwarding payload with full-throughput backpressure.
